meta.title: CMBS Distress Monitor
meta.history_policy: Only verified public prints. Missing months are omitted, not interpolated.
meta.as_of_note: Newest verified observation period in the file is September 2026 (Trepp delinquency, serious delinquency, performing matured balloon, special servicing). Not the compile date.

trepp_overall.name: Trepp US CMBS delinquency (30+ days)
trepp_overall.notes: Headline Trepp CMBS delinquency rate. Performing matured balloons are excluded from the headline rate.

trepp_serious.name: Trepp serious delinquency (60+, foreclosure, REO, non-performing balloon)
trepp_serious.notes: Seriously delinquent rate as defined by Trepp.

trepp_performing_balloon.name: Trepp performing matured balloon
trepp_performing_balloon.notes: Loans past maturity date but current on interest. Separate from headline delinquency.

conclusions: Stock: Trepp 30+ delinquency was 8.02 percent (up 17 bp), serious delinquency 7.87 percent (up 18 bp), and special servicing 11.49 percent (up 7 bp) in September 2026; performing matured balloon was 1.64 percent.
Flow: Five large single-asset single-borrower loans drove much of the delinquency increase; non-performing matured balloons accounted for 68 percent of newly delinquent balances.
Wall: Including performing matured balloons, the rate was 9.66 percent, down 15 bp from August.
withheld: No conclusion: CRED iQ last verified none (no current public print verified this run).
No conclusion: MBA last verified 2026-Q2 (older than expected monthly cadence for comparison).
No conclusion: Morningstar DBRS no surveillance print verified this run.

events.detail: Five largest newly delinquent loans: $1.10 billion eight-property studio-and-office portfolio in Los Angeles, $470.0 million two-tower office complex in Houston, $280.0 million beachfront hotel in Santa Monica, $230.1 million office in Denver, $208.9 million single-tenant office in Silicon Valley. Non-performing matured balloon loans accounted for 68 percent of newly delinquent balances.

sources.name: CMBS Special Servicing Rate Rose Seven Basis Points to 11.49% in September 2026
